hero.description: Plain-language guides for teams planning a custom website or web app: how to choose who builds it, and the technical decisions that decide how it holds up.
hero.title: How to choose a web partner,
hero.titleItalic: and how a website should be built.

intro.paragraph1: Written for the person who makes the call: a founder, marketing lead or operations manager planning a custom website or web app, often without an engineer in the room.
intro.paragraph2: Every statistic and legal rule we cite links to its source. No article quotes a price: prices live on the pricing page, worked out by the same rules as every quote we send. Each article ends with the questions people ask and one next step.
